course_outline_concepts: Bradley-Terry preference model: derivation, identifiability, scaling
Gao 2022 reward-model over-optimisation: inverted-U in policy-vs-RM KL
Reward ensembling (Coste 2023), PairRM, generative reward models
Multi-attribute RMs: Nemotron's 5-dim HelpSteer2, composing attributes at RL time
When to train a new RM vs reuse an existing one vs use a judge-LLM

sources.what_to_extract: BT likelihood sigma(r_w - r_l); InstructGPT/Stiennon NLL loss; scalar head on last-token hidden state; identifiability up to additive constant; Plackett-Luce K-way extension; length-bias patches; BT-as-binary-cross-entropy equivalence; Elo and DPO connections.

Gao 2022 scaling laws; d = sqrt(KL) as natural axis; BoN form R_gold(d) = d(alpha_bon - beta_bon * d); PPO form R_gold(d) = d(alpha_RL - beta_RL * log d); inverted-U shape; policy size barely matters; KL penalty not a free lunch; empirical peak near d=3 for 3M RM.

Coste 2023 K RMs with different seeds/data shards; combinations mean, LCB (mean - lambda*std), min, UWO; peak shift from d=3 to d=5-8; shared-blind-spot counterexample; overhead multiplies reward-forward-pass by K.
PairRM joint encoding f(x,y_A,y_B) -> logit; swap-augmentation; tournament Best-of-N O(N log N); 0.4B DeBERTa matches 7B scalar RM on MixInstruct; DPO pair filtering threshold.

GenRM verdict-token reward = log P('A') - log P('B'); critique-then-verdict adds 3-10 pp on RewardBench; rubric is steerable reward specification; well-calibrated probabilities; compute overhead for critique tokens.
Con-J / Self-Taught Evaluators / J1 line; ~40K synthetic prefs suffice; self-taught judge crosses GPT-4-as-judge in ~3 iterations; judge-as-weapon leakage risk; position-bias consistency swap.
HelpSteer2 5-dim: Helpfulness, Correctness, Coherence, Complexity, Verbosity; Nemotron-4-340B-Reward as filter and judge; DPO then RPO stage; 98% synthetic alignment data with 20K human anchor.
Best-of-N / Worst-of-N extremum pairing; one West-of-N iter matches doubling human pref data; N=16 near-optimal; gain requires argmax-vs-argmin, not argmax-vs-random.

RLAIF parity with RLHF on summarization/helpful/harmless; d-RLAIF reads reward off labeler LM log-prob of 'Response 1 is better'; soft-label BT; CoT preference prompt adds 3-5 pp; same-size labeler still improves over SFT; ~100x cheaper than human labels.

deliverables: figures/rm-overopt.html (interactive inverted-U + ensemble + 5-dim calibration panels, self-contained, ~200-280 lines)
hard_rules: No external CDN references in HTML (inline CSS/JS only)
Derive BT from first principles; show the NLL loss; label what is attested vs inferred
Quote Gao 2022 functional forms exactly (BoN quadratic-in-d, PPO d*(alpha - beta*log d)); label inverted-U peak
Decision framework must be a table tying RM choice (train scalar / PairRM / GenRM / multi-attr / judge-LLM / reuse) to a concrete trigger
HelpSteer2 5-dim names must match attested Nemotron paper labels
